headlines.title: PM Q3 deep dive: smoke-free growth and U.S. investment shape outlook
headlines.summary: Tobacco company Philip Morris International (NYSE:PM) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 5.5% year on year to $11.44 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.36 per share was 1.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.summary: The company is sacrificing near-term margins to defend its nicotine pouch dominance while traditional cigarettes fund the shift.

description: Philip Morris International Inc. operates as a tobacco company. The company offers cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, e-vapor, and oral nicotine products under the IQOS, VEEV, and ZYN brands; and consumer accessories, such as lighters and matches. It also offers wellness products. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
